firm_data.firm_description: Malapero Prisco & Klauber is a law firm that serves New York and New Jersey with years of litigation experience and a commitment to cost-effective defense strategies. The firm has extensive experience in the defense of Labor Law and construction accident litigation, insurance coverage, general insurance defense including motor vehicle, premises liability and products liability, property damage/subrogation and Workers’ Compensation defense services.
notable_facts: Practices in New York and New Jersey, including the United States Supreme Court

email.subject: AI for Malapero Prisco & Klauber, built for your defense litigation
email.body:
Hi Raymond,

Your firm's deep bench in construction and labor law litigation demands precision at scale. As a 13-attorney practice with an AV rating, you're already trusted, but competing on cost-effective defense strategies takes technology most firms your size don't have access to.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping defense shops compete.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
